component.name: VideoScene
component.script:
' LXC 118 serves both the live stream and the remote's peek images. function host() as String return "http://192.168.139.19:8080" end function
sub init() m.video = m.top.findNode("player") m.video.observeField("state", "onVideoState") m.retryTimer = m.top.findNode("retryTimer") m.retryTimer.observeField("fire", "onRetry")
' The remote's peek (#80, ADR-0012): Up/Down shows another pane at ' once as an image over the live video; Back, or a minute without a ' press, returns to the live view. It only looks: the stream keeps ' showing what the compositor decided. m.peek = m.top.findNode("peek") m.bar = m.top.findNode("bar") m.caption = m.top.findNode("caption") m.idleTimer = m.top.findNode("idleTimer") m.idleTimer.observeField("fire", "closePeek") m.items = [] m.index = -1 m.lineup = m.top.findNode("lineup") m.lineup.observeField("content", "onLineup") m.lineup.url = host() + "/peek/index.json" m.lineup.control = "run"
startPlayback() ' The scene, not the Video node, takes the remote: a focused Video ' answers OK, Play and the arrows with trick play on a live stream. m.top.setFocus(true) end sub
sub startPlayback() content = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") content.url = host() + "/master.m3u8" content.streamformat = "hls" content.live = true m.video.content = content m.video.control = "play" end sub
' Publisher restarts kill the HLS session server-side; the Video node ' lands in "error" (or "finished") and never retries on its own. sub onVideoState() s = m.video.state if s = "error" or s = "finished" m.video.control = "stop" m.retryTimer.control = "start" end if end sub
sub onRetry() startPlayback() end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false if key = "up" then stepPeek(-1) return true else if key = "down" then stepPeek(1) return true else if key = "back" then ' Back closes a peek and otherwise does nothing, so a stray press ' can't exit the channel and leave the screen on the Roku home ' screen. (Home still leaves; Roku apps can't catch it.) closePeek() return true end if return false end function
' A new line-up from LXC 118. A peek in progress stays on the same pane ' if it is still listed, and closes if it left. sub onLineup() doc = ParseJson(m.lineup.content) if doc = invalid or type(doc.items) <> "roArray" then return current = invalid if m.peek.visible and m.index >= 0 and m.index < m.items.Count() then current = m.items[m.index].id m.items = doc.items if current = invalid then return m.index = findItem(current) if m.index < 0 then closePeek() else showItem() ' a refresh is not a press: the idle countdown carries on end if end sub
function findItem(id as String) as Integer for i = 0 to m.items.Count() - 1 if m.items[i].id = id then return i end for return -1 end function
' Step through the line-up (rubric order). The first step starts from the ' pane on screen, so Down shows the next one below it; steps wrap around. sub stepPeek(delta as Integer) n = m.items.Count() if n = 0 then m.peek.visible = false showCaption("Nothing to step through yet") restartIdle() return end if if not m.peek.visible then m.index = -1 for i = 0 to n - 1 if m.items[i].showing <> invalid and m.items[i].showing = true then m.index = i end for if m.index < 0 and delta < 0 then m.index = 0 end if m.index = m.index + delta if m.index < 0 then m.index = n - 1 if m.index >= n then m.index = 0 showItem() restartIdle() end sub
sub showItem() item = m.items[m.index] uri = host() + item.image if m.peek.uri <> uri then m.peek.uri = uri m.peek.visible = true position = m.index + 1 text = "Up/Down " + position.ToStr() + " of " + m.items.Count().ToStr() + " · " + item.title if item.showing <> invalid and item.showing = true then text = text + " · on screen now" showCaption(text + " Back: live view") end sub
sub showCaption(text as String) m.caption.text = text m.bar.visible = true end sub
' "start" restarts a running Timer. Do not set "stop" first: a stop and a ' start in the same callback leave the Timer stopped (seen on Roku OS 15.3). sub restartIdle() m.idleTimer.control = "start" end sub
sub closePeek() m.idleTimer.control = "stop" m.peek.visible = false m.bar.visible = false m.index = -1 end sub
